API ReferenceZIdentity APIGroupsGroups Ops Put Users
Groups Ops Put Users
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/groups/:id/users

Replaces the list of users in a specific group using the group ID.

NOTE: This operation completely replaces all existing users in the group.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the group which users needs to be updated.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY ARRAYREQUIRED
Array [
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the referenced entity.

]
Responses
​
200
400

The request has succeeded. All existing users in the group have been replaced.

Schema
Example (auto)
